scope: Read-only MCP bridge P1 authorization remediation

findings: P1 unauthenticated direct exported MCP server factory
P1/P2 false read-only and idempotent hints with audit receipt writes

remediation: All exported server instances require a bearer secret of length at least 32
Actual authorized private-repo lookup tests reject absent/wrong credentials before provider calls
Read-only MCP server and CLI reject audit-required or audit store configuration to prevent writes
Malformed/auth-denied tool calls cannot return validated successful output
limitations: Local Node/HTTP tests only; provider reads in regression are mock fixtures. No remote TLS, ChatGPT connection, audited receipt, independent benchmark quality grading or native interception.
